properties.Script Body:
import java.net.URLEncoder

String PURGE_URL_PATH = "/superservicemap/rest/api/v1/"
String SERVICE_URI_PREFIX = "http://www.disit.org/km4city/resource/iot/"

FlowFile flowFile = session.get();
if( !flowFile ) return

elementId = flowFile.getAttribute( "http.query.param.elementId" )
if( !elementId ){
    flowFile = session.putAttribute( flowFile , "invokehttp.status.code" , "400" )
    session.transfer( flowFile , REL_FAILURE )
    return
}

elementIdTokens = elementId.split( ":" )
if( elementIdTokens.length < 3 ){
    flowFile = session.putAttribute( flowFile , "invokehttp.status.code" , "400" )
    session.transfer( flowFile , REL_FAILURE )
    return
}
organization = elementIdTokens[0]
broker = elementIdTokens[1]
deviceId = elementIdTokens[2]

StringBuilder serviceUri = new StringBuilder( SERVICE_URI_PREFIX )
serviceUri.append( broker ).append( "/" ).append( organization )
          .append( "/" ).append( deviceId )

StringBuilder purgeUrl = new StringBuilder( PURGE_URL_PATH )
if( !purgeUrl.startsWithAny( "/" ) )
    purgeUrl.insert( 0 , "/" )
if( !purgeUrl.endsWithAny( "?") )
    purgeUrl.append( "?" )
purgeUrl.append( "serviceUri=" )
        .append( URLEncoder.encode( serviceUri.toString() , "UTF-8" ) )

flowFile = session.putAttribute( flowFile , "varnish.servicemap.purge.url" , purgeUrl.toString() )
session.transfer( flowFile , REL_SUCCESS )
